purpose: Fresh public-only sustainability audit of representative English News from Google visitor tasks, rich media and bounded contextual evidence.

pages.task: Discover recent Google news and choose a topic or story.
pages.rationale: Homepage with featured carousel, latest-news listing, newsletter and rich media.

pages.task: Find a relevant sustainability announcement in the topic collection.
pages.rationale: Topic listing and public sustainability claim discovery.

pages.task: Read the featured sustainability announcement and identify its stated scope.
pages.rationale: Long-form corporate sustainability article, authorship, dates and audio summary.

pages.task: Read the Fitbit Edge announcement and inspect the embedded demonstration video.
pages.rationale: Product article with native MP4 video; playback interaction is outside this setup task.

pages.task: Inspect the newsletter offer, required email field and privacy explanation without submitting.
pages.rationale: Public form task with a personal-data request and linked privacy policy.

pages.task: Understand the publication, authors and available follow/contact routes.
pages.rationale: Institutional publication information and contact task without sending a message.

journeys.task: From the sustainability listing, open and read the featured Stegra announcement.

success.text: Helping bring the world’s first large-scale, near-zero emissions steel plant online

contextScopes.access-barriers: Anonymous English-language desktop readers (1440×1000, pointer and ordinary browser, no account): from the sustainability topic listing, acknowledge the visible cookie notice and open the featured Stegra article; completion requires the canonical article URL, its complete headline and readable main article content. Keyboard-only, constrained-device and geographic completion are not represented.
contextScopes.data-minimization: The public News from Google newsletter sign-up task at /newsletter-subscribe/ as observed on 2026-11-06: inspect visible requested personal-data categories, mandatory/optional states, purpose and opt-out explanation before entering data or submitting. Retention, downstream deletion and all-system propagation are outside this boundary.
contextScopes.content-lifecycle: The English News from Google sustainability article collection, represented by its topic listing, the September 17, 2026 Stegra article and publication about page as available on 2026-11-06: assess public review/expiry scheduling and an applied update/archive/deletion example with useful historical access. No CMS history or organization-wide lifecycle is represented.
contextScopes.sustainability-goals: News from Google web publication at https://blog.google, as publicly described on 2026-11-06: assess web-service-specific measurable sustainability goals and dated comparable progress. The sustainability topic listing and selected Stegra article are corporate context only and cannot establish the publication’s own goals or operational results.

contextEvidence.scope: Rendered public newsletter subscription page before data entry.
contextEvidence.limitations: Publisher wording and visible controls only; no subscription or email verification was submitted.

contextEvidence.scope: First 10,000 characters of the rendered Google Privacy Policy, including effective date and provided email purpose example.
contextEvidence.limitations: Explicit excerpt of a broad corporate policy; not evidence of blog-specific retention or actual downstream processing. Remaining policy text omitted.

contextEvidence.scope: About News from Google, publication purpose, authorship, follow and contact information.
contextEvidence.limitations: Publisher self-description; no CMS review schedule or publication footprint verified.

contextEvidence.scope: Current English sustainability collection topic page.
contextEvidence.limitations: Sampled listing only; corporate initiatives do not establish audited publication goals.

contextEvidence.scope: September 17, 2026 corporate infrastructure announcement published on the audited blog.
contextEvidence.limitations: Google self-report about industrial materials and data-center construction; not evidence of blog-specific sustainability performance or editorial review execution.

contextEvidence.scope: Complete listing-to-featured-article reading route in anonymous desktop Chromium.
contextEvidence.limitations: Auditor walkthrough, not representative-user testing. No keyboard-only, low-bandwidth, assistive-technology or geographic task verification. Browser-harness CDP connection failed, so isolated Playwright Chromium was used.

questions.question: Can the publication supply its editorial review/expiry schedule and one applied update/archive example?
questions.reason: Optional follow-up; absence from bounded public evidence is unknown, not evidence that no process exists.

questions.question: Are there sustainability targets and comparable progress measurements specifically for blog.google?
questions.reason: Optional follow-up; corporate infrastructure announcements cannot establish publication-specific goals.

assumptions: Public anonymous access to Global (English) content; no internal sources, accounts or submissions.
Desktop first-load measurements are collected later; setup exploration is not performance evidence.
Cookie notice exposes one acknowledgment button; no invented reject/accept choice.
External Google Privacy Policy is contextual evidence only, not an in-origin measured page.
Energy readiness only in this plan; coordinator owns the later sequential experiment.
Separate initial-load energy supplement: homepage and one contrasting content page, three repetitions per page; not a representative whole-site energy average.
ownerPriorities: Public-only audit using representative templates and visitor tasks.
